// Overlay this file into cmd/serve; never run the ordinary application server.
package serve

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/resume-as-code/cmd/tracker"
)

func TestAppKitChannelExportBrowserFixture(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("APPKIT_RAC_EXPORT_BROWSER") != "1" {
		t.Skip("isolated synthetic browser fixture only")
	}
	registries := map[string]*tracker.Registry{
		"coherent":   candidateTwentyChannelFixture(),
		"incomplete": pipelineIncompleteFixture(),
		"zero":       candidateFiveSentNoResponse(),
		"empty":      {Version: 1},
		"no-sent":    {Version: 1, Applications: []tracker.Application{{ID: "fictional-unsent", Company: "Example Synthetic", Role: "Engineer", Status: tracker.StatusLead, CreatedDate: "2099-01-15"}}},
	}
	handlers := make(map[string]http.Handler)
	for name, reg := range registries {
		handlers[name] = serverWithRegistry(t, reg).Handler()
	}
	done := make(chan struct{})
	var once sync.Once
	var host string
	server := httptest.NewUnstartedServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if r.Host != host {
			http.Error(w, "fixture host required", http.StatusForbidden)
			return
		}
		if r.URL.Path == "/__fixture/stop" && r.Method == http.MethodPost && r.Header.Get("X-Fixture-Token") == "synthetic-session" {
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
			// Publish acknowledgement before the owner closes client connections.
			if err := http.NewResponseController(w).Flush(); err != nil {
				t.Errorf("flush stop acknowledgement: %v", err)
			}
			once.Do(func() { close(done) })
			return
		}
		if r.Method != http.MethodGet && r.Method != http.MethodHead {
			http.Error(w, "read-only fixture", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
			return
		}
		switch r.URL.Path {
		case "/pipeline", "/api/export", "/assets/app.css":
		default:
			http.NotFound(w, r)
			return
		}
		selected := ""
		if cookie, err := r.Cookie("fixture-case"); err == nil {
			selected = cookie.Value
		}
		if r.URL.Path == "/pipeline" {
			selected = r.URL.Query().Get("fixture_case")
			if handlers[selected] != nil {
				http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{Name: "fixture-case", Value: selected, Path: "/", HttpOnly: true, SameSite: http.SameSiteStrictMode})
			}
		}
		if handlers[selected] == nil {
			http.Error(w, "known synthetic case required", http.StatusBadRequest)
			return
		}
		w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
		handlers[selected].ServeHTTP(w, r)
	}))
	host = server.Listener.Addr().String()
	server.Start()
	defer server.Close()
	defer server.CloseClientConnections()
	fmt.Printf("APPKIT_RAC_FIXTURE_URL=%s\n", server.URL)
	select {
	case <-done:
	case <-time.After(180 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("fixture timeout")
	}
}
